name: Ganaxolone
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: Metabolism involves several CYPs, including CYP3A4/5, CYP2B6, CYP2C19 and CYP2D6, together with multiple UGT enzymes. Elimination is mainly fecal and urinary as metabolites.
